name: Standard Berth Pad
desc: Vacuum-rated and sized to any standard berth frame, a million regulation sleep pads per cycle are produced by Ko Combine.

name: Domain Ease-Field Berth
desc: A Domain-era berth that floats the sleeper in a shaped micro-agravity field, still running on its original power cell. No yard in the sector can service the field generator, and so far none has needed to.

name: Recruitment Print
desc: A Hegemony Armed Forces recruitment print, one sheet from a press run of ten million. The slogan has not changed since the Second AI War.

name: XIV Battlegroup Pennant
desc: An honor pennant of the Fourteenth Battlegroup, hand-stitched in wool and gold thread. Considerably more verified originals circulate than the Battlegroup ever issued, so buyers look hard at the stitching and the age of the wool. This one is sealed under stasis film, which is period practice.

name: Grav-Cat
desc: Spacers hold that a cat aboard is good luck. This one is of the long-bodied spacer breed, raised in rotation sections and untroubled by null gravity; it hunts whatever comes aboard with the cargo and spends its idle watches staring into the dark corners of the hull.

name: Salvage Raven
desc: A corvid of modified Old Earth stock, bred by belt salvors for pressure tolerance and a good eye for intact metal. During debris sweeps it perches on the sensor board and taps the glass at promising returns.

name: Hydroponic Herb Rack
desc: A hydroponic rack of galley herbs under a grow strip, plumbed into the ship's water recycler.

name: Eventide Rose Bonsai
desc: Eventide's table-strain dwarf roses were bred for aristo households, and they are particular about light, water, and gravity. Aboard a ship the rose needs attention every day.

name: TriPad Dock
desc: A desk dock for the standard TriPad, adding chart overlays and an autofiling service that sorts survey returns as they arrive. The subscription is paid up for years yet, through the estate of some previous owner.

name: Domain Survey Cache
desc: A sealed case of data-slates from the Domain Mineral Exploration Authority, holding survey protocols and calibration tables in working order. The certification stamps glow under scan light. The office that issued them is two centuries gone.

name: Scrap Medal Rack
desc: There is a steady salvage-market trade in campaign medals from navies nobody except historians recognize. This rack came as a single lot; the ribbon has faded, but the brass takes a polish, and the collection makes a respectable showing on a cabin bulkhead.

name: Remnant Facet
desc: A shard of inert glass recovered from a Remnant hull, its faces cut along refracting planes. Assay rates it stable and modestly valuable.

name: Woven Deck Mat
desc: A woven mat of ship-grade fiber, standard issue in half the sector's navies and copied in most of the rest. It gives boots a grip on smooth plating, deadens footfall noise, and rolls up out of the way for inspection.

name: Kumari Silk Rug
desc: Habitat loom work from Kumari Kandam, silk laid over a conductive backing that bleeds static charge into the deck. It absorbs noise, dust, and the occasional dropped tool, and it was requisitioned as morale equipment. The backing also keeps it flat under thrust.

name: Votive Lume-Candles
desc: Electric candles in devotional glass, wired into the cabin's emergency bus so the light survives a power loss. The glow is dim, steady, and easy on dark-adapted eyes.

name: Remnant Lumen Shard
desc: A crystalline fragment pulled from a Remnant wreck, still faintly active. It flickers in time with the ship's passive sensor sweeps and brightens when a live contact is out there.

name: Caff Urn
desc: Dented, relined twice, and older than the ship, this pressure-brewing caff urn of yard-grade steel has outlasted two hulls before her.

name: Faction Drinks Cabinet
desc: A wall cabinet stocked one port at a time: Hegemony navy rum, communion wine out of Gilead, and a Tri-Tachyon product labeled as whiskey.

name: Dockside Songbook Chips
desc: Dockside songbooks are the collected repertoire of the sector's port bars, indexed here by system and vintage across a case of chips.

name: Wardroom Strategikon
desc: A Domain officer-training strategikon with most of its scenario library intact, annotated in three different hands. The scenarios assume fleet strengths no successor navy can field, but the maneuver problems underneath have not aged, and instructors still set the older ones as exercises.

name: Gel-Rest Mattress
desc: Medical agrav gel in a wipe-clean sleeve, the same mattress stock station med-bays fit in their recovery wards. It holds a sleeper level through burn changes and soaks up the shudder of the drive.

name: Officer's Rest Rack
desc: Prize crews strip an officer's rest rack first when a ship is taken, so racks in this condition rarely reach the open market. This one is Hegemony pattern, fold-down frame with regulation bedding, its serial stenciled twice by two different yards.

name: Cryofoam Bunk
desc: Cryosleeper foam is rated to hold a colonist through a century of transit. This bunk was built up from a sleeper ship's spare stock, and it measures the occupant's pulse and cools or warms to match.

name: Stations of the Path Triptych
desc: A folding triptych printed on sanctified tin, its twelve panels showing the Stations of the Path from Ludd's walk.

name: Kill-Mark Stencils
desc: A stencil sheet recovered from a warlord's flagship, kill marks cut in a dozen hull-paint sizes, half of them showing no paint wear at all. The marks that were used correspond to confirmed losses in three systems.

name: Captured Warlord Banner
desc: The personal banner of a warlord, taken in a boarding action and hung with the burn holes unrepaired. Its former owner is alive, at large, and offering a reward for its return well above what any broker would pay.

name: Hull-Rat Cage
desc: A wire cage for a hull-rat that came aboard off a wreck and stayed. The animal reacts to pressure changes and finds slow leaks before the sensors flag them, then sits by the spot until someone comes to look.

name: Cyber-Parrot
desc: A parrot with a wetware vocal implant, sold dockside as a novelty. It repeats damage-control calls with perfect fidelity, and on a few occasions has repeated one minutes before the call was made.

name: Agravifish Bowl
desc: Agravifish from the habitat looms of Kumari Kandam drift in slow schools by their own faint light.

name: Antixenol Planter
desc: Antixenol cuttings from Jangala stock, grown under a red lamp on a spliced med-bay power feed. Steeped in hot water, the leaves make the standard frontier remedy for xeno-allergen exposure.

name: Gilead Prayer Garden
desc: A boxed plot of true Gilead soil under devotional glass, planted with barley and a row of kitchen greens.

name: Volturn Reef Terrarium
desc: A sealed section of living reef from the shallows of Volturn, polyps and weed cycling their own water under a grow lamp.

name: Secondhand Chart Table
desc: A chart table scarred by a century of divider points, bought secondhand with the previous owners' working routes scribed into the surface. A few of those routes check out against survey data and appear on no chart in circulation.

name: Navigator's Ephemeris
desc: A printed slipstream ephemeris carried through two decades of frontier runs, its margins filled with corrections and cautions in several hands.

name: Surveyor's Slate Rack
desc: A rack of Explorarium field slates holding checklists and calibration protocols for survey work as the Domain practiced it.

name: Academy Sample Case
desc: A glass case of xeno-geology reference samples, each labeled with grade and origin in Galatia Academy catalog style. The case is an Academy loan whose paperwork lapsed years ago, and the Academy has never asked for it back. The crew sorts salvage finds against the reference set.

name: Vambrace Fragment
desc: An armor fragment off an Onslaught of the original Mk.I pattern, from the section the yard manuals call the vambrace. It carries no fabrication-rights stamp anywhere, which dates the forging to before the Domain required them.

name: Warlord's Sidearm
desc: An engraved sidearm surrendered when a boarding action went against its owner, and never returned. The engraving records victories in ancient script. The mechanism is a common Hegemony pattern, well kept, and shoots true.

name: Insulfiber Carpet
desc: Seamed together from yard surplus and cut to the cabin's deck plan, this insulfiber carpet deadens footsteps and slows the thermal bleed of the plating in cold running.

name: Tarsus Deck-Quilt
desc: A deck-quilt stitched from liner blankets by a prize crew with time on their hands somewhere off Tarsus. The seams are navy-neat, and the layered fill blocks sound and stray heat better than most purpose-made bedding. Imitations have circulated for years. This is the original.

name: Askonian Ash-Silk Rug
desc: Askonian ash-silk, woven at Sindria from fiber spun out of processed Volturn ash-weed, runs cool underfoot, takes dye poorly, and wears for decades, so most examples keep the gray of the raw thread.

name: Low-Band Glowpanel
desc: Running a glowpanel below its rated output is a spacer economy older than the Collapse. This one came rewired from a dockside shop: light enough to work by, a lower draw on the bus, and an element that outlasts its service rating by years.

name: Fabrique Orbitale Desk Lamp
desc: A desk lamp built around a sealed micro-fusion core, made by the firm that builds fusion lamps at planetary scale. The plate on the base reads "Safe for indoor use."

name: Hegemony Signal Lamp
desc: Still loaded with its drill sequences, this Hegemony signals lamp is the brass-housed pattern issued to training commands.

name: Prize-Crew Still
desc: A compact still of prize-crew manufacture, producing a spirit that is rough but clean. Incidents involving stripped solvent have stopped since it came aboard. It is plumbed in behind the galley recycler, out of the usual inspection path, not that it matters to you.

name: Volturnian Lobster Tank
desc: Live Volturnian lobster, in a tank plumbed and filtered to holding-pen standards. It draws more power than the galley ovens and needs a water contract at every port call. The flavor is said to be exceptional. Engineering ran a heavier power trunk to the cabin to carry it.

name: Phaged Darjeeling Service
desc: Phase-aged tea is leaf of Old Earth stock carried through enough hyperspace crossings to soften the tannins. This service was built for it: heavy pot, shielded caddy, and a certificate of carriage listing every transit. Genuine stock is scarce and difficult to verify by taste alone.

name: Arms-Catalog Subscription
desc: A standing subscription to the sector's arms catalogs, refreshed onto a set of dog-eared TriPads at every port with a comm relay. Current listings put a price on most of what the fleet fights, salvages, or considers buying.

name: Holo-Chess Set
desc: Worn to a shine along the queen files, this tournament-grade holo-chess set has anchored the wardroom's evenings for years.

name: Muse Cabinet
desc: A Domain-era muse cabinet that composes training scenarios fitted to whoever sits at it. The maker's plate certifies it is not an AI but a weighted heuristic network, in full compliance with Domain regulation.

name: Lion's Guard Ceremonial Saber
desc: A ceremonial saber of the Lion's Guard. The blade was never sharpened and the scabbard is welded shut, both per Guard custom for peacetime awards.

name: Motes in Amber
desc: A block of amber resin holding a swarm of drive-field motes recovered after the Ziggurat action. The Academy team that sealed the block certified the resin and declined to certify the contents. The motes still keep formation.

name: Janus Prototype Casing
desc: The housing of a Janus Device prototype, decommissioned and signed out of the Galatia Academy. The active components were removed before transfer.

name: Pilgrim's Twelve-Station Icon
desc: A twelve-panel devotional icon carried the length of the Pilgrim's Path and stamped at every shrine along the way. The panels are fine work on sanctified tin; the frame is scrap iron, in keeping with pilgrim practice.

name: Bornanew Reliquary
desc: Sealed by the ecumene council before the handover, this reliquary comes from the Bornanew mission. Church records list the contents as a settled doctrinal question. The wax and lead of the seal are intact.

name: Rao Ball Invitation, Framed
desc: An invitation to the annual ball of gens Rao on Eventide, gilt-edged and framed under glass. Perhaps two hundred are issued each cycle, and few of those leave the planet. By Eventide etiquette an invitation neither declined nor withdrawn stands open, and this one was never either.

name: Inert Trigger Assembly
desc: The trigger assembly of a planetkiller weapon, certified inert by two separate ordnance boards and kept behind glass. The certification file travels with the assembly and runs to several hundred pages.

name: Kallichore Reading-Room Plate
desc: A brass reading-room plate from the Kallichore Archive, engraved with the word SILENCE in four dead languages. Archive fittings are inventoried and do not circulate.

name: Kanta's Marker
desc: Kanta's protection takes the form of a physical marker, issued from her Den and honored wherever her name carries weight. Pirate crews check for one before they bother with a transponder. Markers attach to a person rather than a ship, and the Den does not replace lost ones.

name: Red Planet Survey Slab
desc: A polished core-sample slab from the shield laboratory on the Red Planet, field notes etched straight into the face. The notes are routine records of depth and composition until the last column, where the flux figures climb well past anything the surrounding notes explain.

name: Imperial Megalobster Tank
desc: A pressurized brine tank holding a breeding-line Volturnian megalobster, surplus from the Diktat's imperial aquaculture program. The line is engineered for banquet mass and parade color. This specimen is still years short of table size.

name: Chicomoztoc Parade Standard
desc: Machine-embroidered to the specification's ceremonial thread count, this Hegemony parade standard comes from the muster fields of Chicomoztoc. It is sized for a parade ground rather than a cabin, and hanging it square is a two-person job.

name: Kazeron Gens Signet Case
desc: A velvet-lined case of five gens signets, one from each of the great houses of Kazeron. The rings assay as genuine gold and period work.

name: Eochu Bres Neural Soother
desc: A Tri-Tachyon executive neural soother from Eochu Bres, tuned to the boardroom stress profile and licensed per user per cycle. Leaving the corporate network voided the warranty and ended the per-cycle billing. The hardware itself runs as built, and takes the edge off a hard watch.

name: Gilead Reliquary Lamp
desc: A reliquary lamp of consecrated glass from Gilead, blessed for shipboard vigils. The element is shrouded so the light falls soft and carries no distance, which suits the devout at prayer.

name: Tesseract Facet Cluster
desc: A cluster of facets cut from a destroyed Tesseract, mounted in a containment frame that, as far as anyone can measure, does nothing. Under direct light the refractions include things that are not in the room.

name: Mothership Chart Core
desc: The navigation chart core of a Domain Explorarium mothership, decades of survey flight in a housing the size of a footlocker. Most frontier charts in circulation are copies of copies of cores like this. This one is an original, and its full index waits on a Domain clearance.

name: Nexus Command Shard
desc: A command shard cut from the heart of a Remnant nexus, still running a closed loop of its old logistics doctrine. Wired into the wardroom game table, it plays a patient, exact positional game. It has also taken to adding items to the maintenance schedule.

name: Lab Sample Carousel
desc: A motorized specimen carousel from a research station, working through a preservation schedule with no author on record. The tube labels follow a cataloging standard two centuries dead, and the samples themselves are ordinary gravel. The mechanism is fine work and runs on a trickle of power.

name: Quartermaster's Lockbox
desc: A quartermaster's lockbox from a military equipment cache, rated against blast, vacuum, and forced entry. The combination reset procedure is stamped inside the lid, and the manifest slot holds a blank form. It bolts straight to standard deck plating.

name: Core-Sample Bookends
desc: Cut square and polished, this pair of drill-core slugs came out of a mining station's assay office. The exposed strata record the rock's whole depositional history in order, and assay apprentices once trained their reading on sections like these.

name: Hab-Grown Vine Basket
desc: Edible vine from an orbital habitat's air garden, its roots bedded in filter sponge in a woven basket. The vine feeds on scrubber exhaust and returns a steady handful of greens each week, and habitat garden stalls sell them ready-grown at most large stations.
